title: Nengo (Brain Maker)
summary: Nengo is an open-source Python framework for building and testing spiking neural networks. It supports multiple backends including FPGA boards, Intel's Loihi chip, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and includes an HTML-5 visualizer. The project offers high-level abstractions compatible with various neuron types, enabling deployment on both conventional and neuromorphic hardware.
tldr: Nengo is a versatile open-source Python framework supporting spiking neural networks across multiple backends including FPGA boards and Intel's Loihi chip.
evidence: Nengo is a versatile open-source Python package designed for building, testing, and applying neural networks.
The framework supports many backends including FPGA boards, Intel's Loihi chip, TensorFlow, PyTorch.
